tools.name: delete_battle
tools.description: Permanently deletes a battle the signed-in player created, for every player in it, with its result. Only the creator can. Confirm with the player first. Requires mcp:write.

tools.name: get_reference_record

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_my_battles, search_reference, get_mission_matchup, list_data_updates, import_roster, copy_roster, list_my_events, get_skill · Private data: get_my_stats, create_battle, submit_battle_action, search_reference, get_reference, get_reference_record, list_reference, list_units, delete_roster, list_my_events, get_my_group, join_group, join_event, start_event_battle, report_table_result, get_skill · Public sink: save_roster, submit_battle_action, submit_event_roster · Destructive: list_my_opponents, delete_battle, simulate_combat, optimize_loadout, delete_roster, get_my_event, check_in_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_my_battles, search_reference, get_mission_matchup, list_data_updates, import_roster, copy_roster, list_my_events, get_skill · Private data: get_my_stats, create_battle, submit_battle_action, search_reference, get_reference, get_reference_record, list_reference, list_units, delete_roster, list_my_events, get_my_group, join_group, join_event, start_event_battle, report_table_result, get_skill · Public sink: save_roster, submit_battle_action, submit_event_roster · Destructive: list_my_opponents, delete_battle, simulate_combat, optimize_loadout, delete_roster, get_my_event, check_in_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
